question: Which of the following is a characteristic of conservative force?

options.text: Energy is dissipated as heat energy
Work done by it in a round trip is not zero
Work done by it is completely recoverable
Work done by it depends upon the path

solution:
The correct answer is __**Work done by it is completely recoverable**__.

__
 
• **Work done by it is completely recoverable is a characteristic of a conservative force**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **Conservative force** is a force with the property that the total work done in a moving particle between two points is independent of the path taken.

 
 
• Conservative force depends only on the position of the particle.
 
• The force is independent of the path
 
• Examples of conservative forces are **Gravitational force, Spring force, Magnetic force and Electric force**.
 
 
 
• On the other hand, **non-conservative forces** are those forces that cause the loss of mechanical energy from the system.
 
 
• But as we know that energy can neither be created nor destroyed so these forces convert mechanical energy into heat, sound, light etc.
 
• The force depends on the path.
 
• Examples of non-conservative forces are **friction, air resistance, and tension in the cord**.
